text:
maya (People Ops): idea: create a 'Welcome Back' parent care kit + reboarding checklist for folks returning from parental leave. small gift + resource packet. thoughts? :baby_bottle:
li (People Ops): love it. do you mean mailed kits for remote folks too?
sara (HRBP): yes please include remote. also want a short manager checklist for 1:1 touchpoints during first month back.
maya (People Ops): plan: $50 physical kit (coffee voucher, notebook, lactation room map, company merch) or $40 e-kit (e-gift + pdf resources). managers get a 1-page checklist + suggested 45-min welcome-back meeting.
jack (Finance): budget ok if we keep avg under $60 per return. how many returns do we expect q2?
li (People Ops): estimate 6-8. at 8 x $60 = $480, fits culture/benefits pilot if approved.
sara (HRBP): approval flow: people-ops creates request, HR signs off, finance issues PO. i'll pre-approve content and checklist copy.
maya (People Ops): logistics: volunteers to assemble kits on-site? also need shipping addresses secured from People Ops forms.
li (People Ops): i can coordinate assembly. can someone draft the form fields?
sara (HRBP): form: name, return date, remote/in-office, shipping address (if remote), manager name, preferred pronouns, opt-in for public welcome in #general (checkbox).
maya (People Ops): privacy note: do NOT include any medical details on the card. include opt-out link.
care-kit-bot: draft form created -> https://forms.gle/fake-carekit  scheduled reminder to managers at 2 weeks before return.
jack (Finance): i'll set aside $600 provisional in PO system for the pilot. please include a line item for shipping.
li (People Ops): i'll draft kit mockup and manager checklist, drop in #people-ops-assets by EOD tomorrow. feedback after that?
sara (HRBP): will review checklist, add language for reasonable workload adjustments.
maya (People Ops): thanks team! goal to launch pilot for returns starting May 4. :seedling:
